0022600168.text: The San Antonio Spurs (4-2, winners of four straight, 2-2 at home and 2-0 on the road) host the Utah Jazz (1-5, losers of four straight) in their seventh game of the season. The Spurs sit 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, and 4th in the West, while the Jazz are 5th in the Northwest, 3.5 games back, and 14th in the West. San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 117-111 win in Salt Lake City on October 28, and it won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and out for the Jazz are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
